_comment_placeholders: This file is illustrative only. JSON has no comment syntax, so explanations
live in docs/development/mcp_development_tooling.md and in this array,
which your MCP client will ignore as an unused key. Do not copy this file
in as an active config without reading that doc first. Client schemas
differ (Claude Code, VS Code + Copilot, Cursor, Codex CLI, ...), so adapt
the shape to whichever client you actually use.
github: uses the official remote GitHub MCP server over OAuth. No token
is stored here. Your client will prompt for a browser login on first use.
If your client/account cannot do remote OAuth, switch to the local
github-mcp-server binary with a fine-grained, read-only PAT supplied via
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in an untracked env file (see mcp.env.example).
context7: CONTEXT7_API_KEY is optional. Omit it to use Context7
unauthenticated at a lower rate limit, or set it from an untracked env
file — never as a literal value in this file or on a command line.
playwright: --output-dir and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH must point under
your D-drive (or equivalent non-C) tooling root. --allowed-origins
is an origin allowlist for navigation convenience, not a network
security boundary; it does not constrain every redirect or request.
huggingface: do not hand-write this entry. Generate it from
https://huggingface.co/settings/mcp while logged in, select your coding
client, and paste the exact snippet it produces.

huggingface._comment: PLACEHOLDER ONLY - replace with the exact snippet from https://huggingface.co/settings/mcp for your client
